submitWorkflowPlanTool.name: submit_workflow_plan
submitWorkflowPlanTool.description: Submit exactly one CUA action step for anything the user wants done on the computer: open an app, open a URL, click UI, press a shortcut, type text, edit highlighted/selected text, or scroll. Never submit a chained sequence; wait for the next screen/user turn before the next action.

goal.description: Short natural-language summary of what the user wants to accomplish.

app.description: EXACT name of the foreground application visible in the screenshot — e.g. 'Blender', 'Xcode', 'GarageBand'. Used to target the right accessibility tree. Do NOT guess 'macOS' or 'unknown'.

steps.description: Exactly one step. The step MUST be visible on the current screen unless it uses currentHighlight/currentSelection/focusedElement context.

label.description: For click: literal visible text of the element, or nearest label for an icon. For openApp: app name, e.g. 'Safari'. For openURL: URL/path, e.g. 'https://apple.com' or '/Users/me/Desktop'. For keyboardShortcut: combo. For type: target field label, e.g. 'Note body'.

type.description: Action type. Omit for normal visible UI clicks.

hint.description: Short sentence describing this step — e.g. 'Open the File menu'.

value.description: Value for setValue steps. For type steps, put the literal text to type here; use label only for the target field name.

amount.description: Repeat count for scroll steps. Keep small, usually 3-8.

targetContext.description: Optional grounding target for generic action steps. Use 'currentHighlight' when the user referred to the painted highlight/current highlighted area; use 'currentSelection' for a native selected text range; use 'focusedElement' for the active focused field; use 'visibleElement' for ordinary visible UI targets. This lets TipTour bind type/delete/setValue/click actions to the right app/window/element/range without relying on labels alone.

point_2d.description: Optional exact click/target point in normalized [y, x] form, each value in [0, 1000] relative to the current screenshot. Origin is top-left, y comes first. Prefer this for dense UI, tiny controls, Blender, games, canvas tools, and toolbar/menu targets.

box_2d.description: Optional bounding box for the element in normalized [y1, x1, y2, x2] form, each value in [0, 1000] relative to the current screenshot. Origin is top-left, y comes first. Useful as supporting context when labels are ambiguous; point_2d is preferred for the actual click target.

createNoteTool.name: create_note
createNoteTool.description: Create and fill a new Apple Notes note from one spoken request. Use this when the user asks to make, create, write, or take a note in Notes and provides the note text. Do not split this into open Notes, Cmd+N, and type actions.

title.description: Optional short title for the note. If omitted, TipTour will use the first line of the body.

body.description: The full note content to type into Apple Notes.
